label: Resolve ambiguity
hint: Interpret numeric dates, missing years and abbreviated years.
paragraphs: Short dates leave room for interpretation: which number is the month, which is the day, and which year was intended? The parser uses the preferred date order, expected period and reference date to choose a reading.

With day-first order, 10-11-12 becomes 10 November 2012. For 01/02, the missing year is inferred as 2027. In feb 11 80, the month is explicit and the abbreviated year becomes 1980. The written results show each interpretation.
